offers_products.reason: Food and beverage sales at venues and courses are incidental to the main offering, which is golf and entertainment experiences.

offers_services.reason: Operates golf courses, Drive Shack venues and Puttery venues, and manages courses and country clubs for others.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Golfers and social players pay for rounds, hitting bays, mini golf, dining and club memberships.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Puttery and Drive Shack host corporate events, and American Golf manages courses for municipalities and clubs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is pay-per-visit rounds, bay time and food and beverage; private club dues are a smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Golf outings, entertainment venues and corporate events are discretionary spending that customers can cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent amounts for rounds, bay time, mini golf and meals.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for access to courses, venues, technology and hospitality, not mainly for staff expertise.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual golfers and groups; corporate events and municipal management are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and leases golf courses and large entertainment venues, and needs heavy property investment to open new venues.
